title: K. That Time I Got Reincarnated As A String Problem

legend: Hina has a string s$$$s$$$ of lowercase letters and question marks. She wants to fill each question mark with a lowercase letter so that she is left with a string of only lowercase letters. Hina will then count over all permutations of letters in her string, the number of unique strings that can be formed. For instance, the string aab$$$aab$$$ has 6$$$6$$$ permutations, [aab,aba,aab,aba,baa,baa]$$$[aab, aba, aab, aba, baa, baa]$$$ but only form 3$$$3$$$ unique strings.
Over all 26# of ?'s$$$26^{\#\text{ of ?'s}}$$$ ways Hina can fill in the question marks, what is the expected number of unique strings that can be formed?
input: The first line will contain one integer T$$$T$$$, the number of testcases (1≤T≤500)$$$(1 \leq T \leq 500)$$$.

Each following line will contain a string s$$$s$$$, the string Hina wants you to find the answer for. s$$$s$$$ will only contain lowercase letters or question marks (1≤|s|≤103)$$$(1 \leq |s| \leq 10^3)$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of |s|$$$|s|$$$ over all testcases will not exceed 5⋅103$$$5 \cdot 10^3$$$.
Tests in subtasks will be numbered from 1−20$$$1 - 20$$$ with samples ignored.
Tests 1−4$$$1-4$$$ will have no strings that contain question marks.
Tests 5−6$$$5-6$$$ will have all strings only contain question marks.
Tests 7−10$$$7-10$$$ will have the sum of all string lengths not be greater than 100$$$100$$$.
The remaining testcases have no additional constraints.
output: For each testcase, output a single integer E$$$E$$$, the expected number of permutations over all ways to fill in the question marks modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$. The expected value can be represented as fraction xy$$$\frac{x}{y}$$$ and you will output E$$$E$$$ where x=E⋅ymod109+7$$$x = E \cdot y \mod 10^9 + 7$$$.
note: For the string a?b$$$a?b$$$, when we fill the ?$$$?$$$ in for a$$$a$$$ or b$$$b$$$, there are 3$$$3$$$ permutations but for any letter, there are 6$$$6$$$. This gives us an expected value of 3⋅2+6⋅2426=538461548mod109+7$$$\frac{3 \cdot 2 + 6 \cdot 24}{26} = 538461548 \mod 10^9 +7$$$.

For the string trust$$$trust$$$, there are no ?$$$?$$$'s and there can be shown to exist exactly 60$$$60$$$ unique strings that can be formed from permuting the letters, giving an expected value of 60$$$60$$$.
For the second sample, you should watch that particular anime <3.

a?b
bestgirl?

在 Hina 填写问号的所有 26# of ?'s$$$26^{\#\text{ of ?'s}}$$$ 种方式中，能够形成的不同字符串数量的期望值是多少？

接下来的每一行包含一个字符串 s$$$s$$$，你需要为该字符串求出答案。s$$$s$$$ 只包含小写字母或问号 (1≤|s|≤103)$$$(1 \leq |s| \leq 10^3)$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数 E$$$E$$$，即所有填充问号的方式中排列数的期望值对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模的结果。期望值可以表示为分数 xy$$$\frac{x}{y}$$$，你需要输出 E$$$E$$$，其中 x=E⋅y mod 109+7$$$x = E \cdot y \mod 10^9 + 7$$$。
